adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` the `--category/-c` option is removed and all logic for resolving `category_id` is deleted, so existing invocations that relied on category assignment can no longer work. The import flow is also changed from creating the topic via `PostCreator.new(... category: category_id)` to `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, which fetches `t[:link]` over HTTP (`open(url).read` in `TopicEmbed.import_remote`) and then calls `TopicEmbed.import`, which returns `nil` unless the URL matches `^https?://`. Since `disqus.thor` only imports replies when `post.present?`, a nil/failed remote fetch causes the thread’s posts to be skipped with no alternative path shown in the diff.
